property_summary: If transfer returns true (does not revert), it must leave c's public from and caddress unchanged and return true; if the caller restriction would block the call (msg.sender != from) then the call reverts.
Calling transfer either reverts, or returns true (no revert) and leaves both public variables from and caddress unchanged.
For any non-empty equal-length inputs, calling transfer either reverts or returns true (no other return possible).
For any non-empty equal-length inputs where this test contract calls transfer, the call either reverts or returns true; if it returns, it must return true (i.e., no other non-reverting return value).
For any single-recipient transfer with a positive uint amount, calling transfer either reverts or returns true.
If transfer returns true (does not revert), it preserves c.from and c.caddress public getters unchanged and returns true only when called by the designated owner and with matching array lengths > 0.
If c.transfer(...) does not revert when called by this test contract, then c.from() must equal address(this) (i.e., only the designated owner can make it succeed).

property_summary: If c.transfer(_tos,v) does not revert when called, then c.from() equals the InvMutTest contract address (i.e., only the designated owner can make it succeed).
If c.transfer(_tos,v) returns (does not revert), it must return true (i.e., successful call yields true).
If transfer is called with non-empty matching arrays by the deployed owner (this contract), it must either revert or return true (i.e., it cannot return false).
